scope: One bounded restart/exchange reliability increment; synthetic local evidence only; UNSCORED
criteria: Demonstrate an actual baseline gap with an isolated deterministic adversarial regression before changing implementation; if none exists, do not invent a fix.

After a response has been handed to the controller, interruption before exchange acknowledgment cannot cause automatic resubmission of that same response, including rejected ACTION and premature COMPLETE.
A durable consumption claim binds the request, full input, exact output, launch and reviewed code/state evidence; malformed or conflicting evidence must fail closed.
Concurrent/restarted consumption must produce at most one controller submission per response; identical result delivery stays idempotent and conflicting bytes reject.
Uncertain launch remains pending without replacement launch; uncertain consumption requires recovery or review; recovery cannot replay ambiguous started work.

Verified receipts and committed WAIT/BLOCK decisions still reconcile after acknowledgment loss; WAIT does not run work before its deadline, BLOCK/COMPLETE do not start workers, premature COMPLETE does not mark completion.
Keep all earlier adapter regressions passing; unchanged pulse controller/protocol and preserved old artifacts; no external scheduler/provider/model API or production effects.
Final source requires independent adversarial review, source hashes, and an isolated remote branch whose exact changed blobs are verified; retain UNSCORED and stronger Atlas R3/Gage R2 limits.
